summary: Tested the new useFavorites hook + interactive heart on the Stays page. Backend favorites endpoints (POST /api/properties/{id}/like, GET /api/liked-property-ids, GET /api/liked-properties) all pass. Frontend signed-out heart shows sign-in toast and does not navigate. Signed-in heart toggles fill to #FF385C, aria-pressed=true, does not navigate. Card body still navigates to /property/{id}. Liked tab in dashboard correctly shows the favorited property after like. 6-column grid confirmed at 1920px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: useFavorites hook is clean, properly stops event propagation on heart click — exactly what is needed to prevent card navigation.
Stays.jsx (667 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting StaysCard, AreaRow, FiltersModal into separate files in a future refactor.
Heart button uses aria-pressed and aria-label that correctly flip between 'Save to favorites' and 'Remove from favorites' — good accessibility.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-created like on property 7927f009-44e9-4e0f-9d06-21d50ee0cf43 was toggled back off at cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_favorites.py covers all 3 favorites endpoints incl. full toggle cycle + 404. Frontend Stays cards use data-testid `stays-card-{id}` and `stays-card-like-{id}`. Liked SVG fill is `#FF385C`, unliked is `rgba(0,0,0,0.35)`. Login route is /auth/login (not /login). Renter dashboard Liked tab is reachable via [data-testid*='liked'] and reads from /api/liked-properties.
verified_flows: Signed-out heart click → sign-in toast, no navigation
Signed-in heart click → fill becomes #FF385C, aria-pressed=true, no navigation, persists to backend
Second heart click → unliked (fill reverts, aria-pressed=false)
Liked tab in dashboard shows favorited property
Grid renders 6 columns at xl (1920px) viewport
404 returned for like on non-existent property
401/403 returned without auth on all 3 endpoints
